tools.name: demurrage_register_hold
tools.description: Register a hold on a pooled resource (one free registration per operator, ever; then $0.01/hold x402; fleet plan included). Requires api_token, agent, resource_class, task, budget; optional state, x_payment.

tools.name: demurrage_query_hold
tools.description: Tariff query: free time left, tier, next-hour cost, accrued, idle ratio (one free query per operator, ever; then $0.005/query x402; fleet plan included). Requires api_token, hold_id; optional x_payment.

tools.name: demurrage_evaluate_hold
tools.description: Evaluate a hold: accrual + notice ladder + budget debit + cap snapshot-and-release. Requires api_token, hold_id.

tools.name: demurrage_release_hold
tools.description: Voluntarily release a hold. Requires api_token, hold_id.

tools.name: demurrage_restore_capsule
tools.description: Restore a snapshot capsule into a NEW hold (hash verified; tampered capsules refused). Requires api_token, capsule_id, budget.

tools.name: demurrage_account
tools.description: Own account state: trial remaining, fleet plan, service charges. Requires api_token.
